lines.t: ‎Verse 1 (slow, reflective – echoing Psalm 23 rhythm)
‎YahuShua is my Shepherd,
‎I shall not want, I shall not lack.
‎He makes me lie down in green pastures,
‎Leads me by still waters, brings me back.
‎He restores my soul, restores my soul,
‎Guides me in paths of righteousness,
‎For His name’s sake, for His holy name.
‎YahuShua HaMashiach!
‎My King, my Redeemer, forever!
‎Your mercy endures, Your truth ascends high!
‎Holy, holy, holy is Your name!
‎Let all the earth sing praise to You!
‎Come out, come out, My people, come!
‎Worship in spirit, worship in truth—
‎The Father seeks such as these!
‎YahuShua is King! YahuShua is King!
‎ "YahuShua HaMashiach, The Holy One of Israel... For HE IS WHO HE IS, And there is none like Him!... Says The LORD."
‎Behold, I stand at the door and knock,
‎Hear My voice, open wide the door.
‎I will come in, dine with you, you with Me,
‎Overcome, and sit upon My throne—
‎As I overcame, sat with My Father,
‎Forever in glory, forever in light.
‎I am the Way, the Truth, the Life—
‎No one comes to the Father but through Me.
‎Return to Me with all your heart,
‎I blot out transgressions, remember no more.
‎YahuShua, Shepherd of the flock,
‎One flock, one Shepherd, forevermore!
‎"And they shall all become one flock, with one Shepherd. Behold, I shall be their God, and they shall be My people, forever! Says The LORD."
‎YahuShua HaMashiach!
‎My King, my Redeemer, forever!
‎Your mercy endures, Your truth ascends high!
‎Holy, holy, holy is Your name!
‎Let all the earth sing praise to You!
‎Come out, come out, My people, come!
‎Worship in spirit, worship in truth—
‎The Father seeks such as these!
‎YahuShua is King! YahuShua is King!
‎YahuShua is King forever!
